description: Na₂Si₂O₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pca2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.90 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.87 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.67 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.68 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Si atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two Si atoms.
